# Nx: Smart Monorepos · Fast Builds Get to green PRs in half the time. Nx optimizes your builds, scales your CI, and fixes failed PRs. Built for developers and AI agents. This package is a [JavaScript/TypeScript plugin for Nx](https://nx.dev/js/overview). ## Getting Started ### Creating an Nx Workspace **Using `npx`** ```bash npx create-nx-workspace ``` **Using `npm init`** ```bash npm init nx-workspace ``` **Using `yarn create`** ```bash yarn create nx-workspace ``` ### Adding Nx to an Existing Repository Run: ```bash npx nx@latest init ``` ## Documentation & Resources - [Nx.Dev: Documentation, Guides, Tutorials](https://nx.dev) - [Intro to Nx](https://nx.dev/getting-started/intro) - [Official Nx YouTube Channel](https://www.youtube.com/@NxDevtools) - [Blog Posts About Nx](https://nx.dev/blog)
